nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the term $s_k(n)$ of the generalized Sylvester sequence is positive.
nodes.title: Positivity of the generalized Sylvester sequence

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the generalized Sylvester sequence $(s_k(n))_{k \ge 0}$ satisfies $s_{k+1}(n) = s_k(n)^2 - s_k(n) + 1$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the generalized Sylvester sequence

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the generalized Sylvester sequence $(s_k(n))_{k \ge 0}$ satisfies $s_0(n) = n + 1$.
nodes.title: Initial term of the generalized Sylvester sequence

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the generalized Sylvester sequence $(s_k(n))_{k \ge 0}$ is the sequence of natural numbers defined by $s_0(n) = n + 1$ and $s_{k+1}(n) = s_k(n)^2 - s_k(n) + 1$ for $k \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Generalized Sylvester sequence

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $x$ and $y$, the conditions $n \ge 3$, $x \ge 1$, $y \ge 1$, $\gcd(x, y) = 1$ and $x^2 + 7 = 4y^n$ hold if and only if $(n, x, y)$ is $(3, 5, 2)$, $(5, 11, 2)$ or $(13, 181, 2)$ (Luca–Tengely–Togbé).
nodes.title: Coprime solutions of $x^2 + 7 = 4y^n$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$, $x$ and $y$, the conditions $n \ge 3$, $x \ge 1$, $y \ge 1$, $\gcd(x, y) = 1$ and $x^2 + 3 = 4y^n$ hold if and only if $n \ge 3$ and either $x = y = 1$ or $(n, x, y) = (3, 37, 7)$ (Luca–Tengely–Togbé).
nodes.title: Coprime solutions of $x^2 + 3 = 4y^n$

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. The natural numbers $x$ such that $x = S_n$ for some $n$ and $x = 2^r - 1$ for some $r \ge 1$ are exactly $3$ and $7$.
nodes.title: Mersenne numbers in the Sylvester sequence

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $i \ge 1$, $S_{2i} \equiv 7 \pmod{10}$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers of even index modulo 10

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n \ge 1$, $S_n$ has a prime divisor $p$ with $p \equiv 3 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Prime divisors congruent to 3 modulo 4 of Sylvester numbers

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n \ge 3$, $S_n \equiv 43 \pmod{1764}$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers modulo 1764

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n \ge 2$, $S_n \equiv 7 \pmod{36}$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers modulo 36

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n \ge 1$, $S_n \equiv 3 \pmod 4$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers modulo 4

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n$ other than $1$ and $2$ there are no natural numbers $a \ge 2$ and $m \ge 2$ with $S_n = a^m + 1$ or $S_n = a^m - 1$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers next to perfect powers

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $n$ there are no natural numbers $a \ge 2$ and $m \ge 2$ with $S_n = a^m$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers are not perfect powers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the $n$-th Sylvester number $S_n$ is not a perfect number.
nodes.title: No Sylvester number is perfect

nodes.summary: The Sylvester numbers $S_0, S_1, S_2, \dots$ are the natural numbers given by $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$ for $n \ge 0$, so the sequence begins $2, 3, 7, 43, 1807, \dots$. It is the generalized Sylvester sequence with parameter $1$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For every $i \ge 1$, $S_{2i+1} \equiv 3 \pmod{10}$.
nodes.title: Sylvester numbers of odd index modulo 10

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For all natural numbers $k$ and $n$ with $1 \le k \le n$, the integer $S_k^2 + 1$ divides the integer $S_n - (-1)^{n-k} S_k$.
nodes.title: Alternating divisibility for Sylvester numbers

nodes.summary: Let $(S_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Sylvester sequence, $S_0 = 2$ and $S_{n+1} = S_n^2 - S_n + 1$. For all natural numbers $k$, $m$ and $n$ with $k \ge 1$, $m \ge k$ and $n \ge k$, the integer $(S_k - 1)^2$ divides $S_n - S_m$.
nodes.title: Divisibility of differences of Sylvester numbers

nodes.summary: Let $S_n$ denote the $n$-th Sylvester number. A natural number $x$ equals $S_n$ for some $n$ and satisfies $2x = m(m + 1)$ for some natural number $m \ge 1$ if and only if $x = 3$.
nodes.title: The only triangular Sylvester number is $3$
Number Theory

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
